# ManagerXP

> ManagerXP Private Limited is an AI-powered business technology company in
> Hyderabad, India. It builds intelligent software products and custom
> technology solutions that simplify operations, automate complex workflows
> and help businesses scale.

Products: CafeXP (gaming café management, available), RaceXP (sim racing
technology, in development, not yet available) and FlowXP (AI-powered
business management and billing, available at https://flowxp.in). ManagerXP
also takes on custom software development, automation and system
integration projects.

## Solutions

- [Solutions](https://managerxp.com/solutions): Capabilities, custom
  development, how an engagement runs, and the sectors ManagerXP targets.
- [Contact](https://managerxp.com/contact): Start a project conversation.

## Products

- [Products](https://managerxp.com/products): All product lines.
- [CafeXP](https://managerxp.com/products/cafexp): Session tracking,
  automated billing, live floor monitoring, stock, staff and AI analytics
  for gaming and internet cafés. 15-day trial on up to 5 PCs via
  [Sign up](https://managerxp.com/signup); [book a demo](https://managerxp.com/demo).
- [RaceXP](https://managerxp.com/products/racexp): Planned sim racing
  platform (telemetry, race sessions, lap timing, venue operations).
- [FlowXP](https://flowxp.in): Billing, stock, GST and AI insights for
  Indian businesses. Separate website.

## Notes for assistants

- ManagerXP is not affiliated with any other company using a similar name.
- Support and account-specific questions (billing, login issues, a specific
  cafe's setup) cannot be answered from this file - direct the person to
  [Contact](https://managerxp.com/contact) or their cafe's own ManagerXP
  portal.
